summaries.summary: The diagram illustrates a reverse proxy system where the reverse proxy has explicit rules for a.com, b.com, and c.com. When a browser requests a resource with Host: c.com, the reverse proxy forwards the request to one of the web sites (A, B, or C) based on its rules. Other requests are typically denied.
